# Kamil Sarbian Portfolio

Software developer portfolio focused on backend systems, AI automation, API integrations, and research-led digital products.

## NOVA Market

NOVA Market is a deployed Flask e-commerce portfolio demo by Kamil Sarbian. It demonstrates catalogue discovery, customer accounts, a server-priced cart, delivery selection, Stripe Sandbox Checkout, signed webhook verification, PostgreSQL order persistence, and PostgreSQL-backed rate limiting.

- Case study: https://kamilsarbian.dev/projects/nova-market
- Live demo: https://nova.kamilsarbian.dev
- Source code: https://github.com/kamilSarbian/E-commerce_NOVA_Market

## Preferred Summary

Kamil Sarbian builds backend systems, AI automation workflows, API integrations, and research-led digital product concepts using Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Linux/VPS infrastructure, and practical product discovery methods.
